info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for real-time updates to corporate loan deposit lending parameters. It enables financial institutions to adjust lending criteria dynamically based on specific requirements. This facilitates responsiveness to market changes and enhances customer service by ensuring that corporate lending conditions remain relevant. Common consumers of this API include banking software developers and financial analysts seeking to optimize lending operations. Utilize this endpoint to keep your lending parameters accurate and up-to-date.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific corporate loan identified by the provided loan ID. Make sure to include the necessary fields in the request to modify the loan information appropriately.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific information related to the corporate loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that the necessary fields are included in the payload to successfully modify the loan details.

200.description: The request was successful and the loan details were updated.
